summary: DS2-R1 is resolved: quoted Yarn Berry selectors and quoted pnpm package keys now take precedence over package.json declarations. Approval remains withheld because valid pnpm importer entries are not read and malformed Yarn/pnpm lockfiles do not produce the required lockfile_unreadable diagnostic.

findings.title: Read pnpm importer resolutions and diagnose unreadable YAML lockfiles
findings.detail: The DS-2 contract explicitly requires pnpm importers/packages. A valid pnpm v9 importer containing tailwindcss version 4.3.0, while package.json declares ^3.0.0, is reported as package_json (^3.0.0): the current patterns only match package keys with an @version. Also, arbitrary malformed yarn.lock or pnpm-lock.yaml content returns an empty lock result without a lockfile_unreadable check. Parse the root importer dependency version as an exact resolution when package entries are unavailable, mark malformed/unparseable Yarn and pnpm files as lockfile_unreadable, and add fixtures for both conditions.

evidence.description: The prior correction resolved quoted lockfile keys and was validated before this independent finding.
The reviewed resolver did not read pnpm root-importer dependency versions or emit unreadable diagnostics for malformed YAML.
